subject: FinBank: Deployment mode & data residency - follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Schmidt <laura.schmidt@finbank.eu>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: FinBank: Deployment mode & data residency - follow-up

Hi Laura

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs you shared:
- Primary requirement: EU-only data residency for production workloads (processing and storage must remain in EU).
- APAC availability is a secondary requirement (nice-to-have for later expansion).
- Strong preference for customer-managed keys (KMS) and audit logs for regulatory reporting.
- Procurement/legal will need standard SOC 2 documentation and answers to a short security questionnaire.

Redwood deployment options that map to your needs:
1) Hosted API (fastest): available in EU regions; we can pin processing to EU but need to confirm cross-region DR/edge routing constraints for strict EU-only guarantees. Good for low-friction POC, but we should validate contractual residency clauses.
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools): deployed in an EU region, gives stronger isolation and predictable throughput. Supports customer KMS integration and longer retention of audit logs.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): full control over networking and residency recommended if you require legally binding EU-only processing and control over encryption keys.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm whether production must be EU-only by contract (yes/no)?
- I'll loop in our solutions lead (Marissa) to coordinate a technical deep-dive on KMS, network/topology, and region availability.
- I attached a mutual action plan and our EU/APAC region availability sheet to help pick the right path.

If you're available, let's schedule a 45-min technical deep-dive next week (Marissa will lead). I'm free Tue/Wed afternoon CET what works for you?

Thanks
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, eu-apac-region-availability-sheet.xlsx, redwood-data-residency-whitepaper.pdf

From: Laura Schmidt <laura.schmidt@finbank.eu>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finbank.eu>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: FinBank: Deployment mode & data residency - follow-up

Hi Aditya

Thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Confirmed: production systems must be EU-only by contract. No processing or storage outside EU for live data. Disaster recovery in a second EU region is acceptable, but no failover to non-EU.
- APAC: interesting for future expansion, but not a blocker for our go/no-go.
- KMS: we need customer-managed keys (we store keys in our own KMS and expect integration).
- Compliance artifacts: please share SOC 2 Type II and the completed security questionnaire. Our procurement will also want a stub SOW and an overview of SLA for latency/uptime in EU regions.

Two quick questions for the team: 
1) Can Hosted API be contractually restricted to EU-only processing? If not fully certifiable, we'll likely need either Dedicated capacity with contractual residency guarantees or Private VPC.
2) For Dedicated capacity, can you confirm support for customer KMS and audit log retention for 7 years?

We're aiming to decide between Hosted (fast POC) vs Dedicated/Private (production guarantees) by the end of next week. Happy to join the technical deep-dive  Tue 13 Oct 09:00 CET would work for me.

Best,
Laura Schmidt
Head of AI Platforms | FinBank
laura.schmidt@finbank.eu

Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: FinBank: Deployment mode & data residency - follow-up

Marissa / Neha

Looping you in on FinBank's clarifications. Key asks: EU-only production (no non-EU processing), customer-managed KMS, SOC 2 + 7-year audit log retention ask, procurement wants SOW + SLA. Laura is available for a technical deep-dive on Tue 13 Oct 09:00 CET.

My recommendation:
- For POC: Hosted API pinned to EU region can work if Legal is OK with a contractual residency clause AND we can demonstrate EU-only processing in practice (no cross-region routing).
- For production: Recommend Dedicated capacity deployed in EU (or Private VPC if they insist on full network isolation and on-prem keys). Dedicated gives a faster ramp than Private and still supports KMS integration and stricter audit logs.

Action items for Solutions & Security:
- Marissa: please prepare a short doc confirming: (a) whether Hosted API can be contractually restricted to EU-only processing, and (b) our default cross-region routing/failover behavior and how to disable non-EU failover.
- Neha: can you confirm KMS and audit log retention capabilities for Dedicated vs Private (including any additional ops/SLA impacts)?

I attached the mutual action plan and region sheet we sent to the customer. I'll await your notes so I can respond to Laura and share SOC2 + questionnaire items.

Thanks
Aditya

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, eu-apac-region-availability-sheet.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Schmidt <laura.schmidt@finbank.eu>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: FinBank: Deployment mode & data residency - follow-up

Hi Laura / Aditya

Thanks for the clear summary, Laura. Quick answers and next steps from the Solutions team: 

Short answers:
- Hosted API: we can pin requests to an EU region for routing and processing, but Hosted is a multi-tenant control plane for contractual EU-only guarantees we typically recommend Dedicated or Private. That said, for a short POC we can provide documented routing evidence and a contractual residency clause; production-level guarantees are stronger on Dedicated/Private.
- Dedicated: supports customer-managed KMS integration (Bring Your Own Key) and configurable audit log retention. 7-year retention is supported but may require an add-on/archival configuration - I'll include cost/options in the follow-up.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): provides the clearest legal residency and networking controls (recommended if your legal team needs absolute guarantees).

Deliverables we'll share before Tue 13 Oct: 
1) SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) + completed security questionnaire.
2) Short technical note: Hosted routing behavior and how to enforce EU-only processing; Dedicated/Private KMS and audit log capabilities.
3) Draft SOW and SLA summary for EU Dedicated deployment options.

I'll send the materials via secure link (Drive folder) by EOD Mon 5 Oct and include proposed agenda for the 45-min technical deep-dive. If this looks good, Aditya can you confirm the meeting invite for Tue 13 Oct 09:00 CET?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
